items.en: Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode
items.zh: 在 Claude 应用网关的 `managed.policies[]` 中新增 `code` 键：其设置与 `cli` 相同，也会在 Claude Desktop 的 Code 标签页中生效；与 `desktop` 并列时，会开启 Claude Desktop 的网关模式

items.en: Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
items.zh: 在 subagent frontmatter 和 `--agents` 定义中新增 `autoCompactWindow`，使 subagent 可以比主对话的上下文窗口更早触发自动上下文压缩

items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
items.zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL`，让所有 workflow agent 运行在同一个模型上，而其他 subagent 保持各自的模型

items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
items.zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` 环境变量，为重试过载（529）请求时的退避设置更长的最大延迟

items.en: Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name
items.zh: 在 `/plugin` 中，对因另一个已启用的 plugin 同名而省略了 hooks 的 plugin 新增提示

items.en: Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room
items.zh: 为 Read 工具新增 `allow_large` 选项，使 Claude 在需要读取整个文件且上下文有余量时，可以在一次调用中读取超出常规大小限制的文本文件

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Added a status filter to the Sessions and Runners lists on a self-hosted environment's Activity tab in admin settings; you can pick several statuses at once
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 在管理设置中自托管环境 Activity 标签页的 Sessions 和 Runners 列表新增状态筛选；可同时选择多个状态

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added creating, editing and deleting workspace and channel memory files on the Activity page's Memory tab for members with the Claude Tag Admin permission
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 在 Activity 页面的 Memory 标签页中，为拥有 Claude Tag Admin 权限的成员新增创建、编辑和删除 workspace 与 channel 记忆文件的功能

items.en: Updated `/cost`, the status line, `--max-budget-usd` and the SDK's cost figures to price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at $0.10 per million tokens (was $0.20)
items.zh: 更新 `/cost`、状态栏、`--max-budget-usd` 和 SDK 的费用数字，将 Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取定价为每百万 tokens $0.10（原为 $0.20）

items.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill: lighter violet for the seventh series in light mode, softer primary text in dark mode, and compact y-axis labels like 1K
items.zh: 更新内置 dataviz skill：浅色模式下第七个系列改用更浅的紫色，深色模式下主文本更柔和，并采用如 1K 的紧凑 y 轴标签

items.en: Changed the default limit on MCP tool descriptions sent up front and on MCP server instructions from 2,048 to 4,096 characters
items.zh: 将预先发送的 MCP 工具描述和 MCP 服务器指令的默认上限从 2,048 个字符改为 4,096 个字符

items.en: Changed `←`: a turn or `!` command started while the session moves to the background is now stopped instead of finishing out of sight
items.zh: 变更 `←`：当 session 转入后台时，已开始的回合或 `!` 命令现在会被停止，而不是在后台继续完成

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed Claude in Chrome to ask before browser actions in every session, including one connected with `@browser`, as the terminal does; allowing a site for the session stops repeat asks
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更 Claude in Chrome：与终端一致，在每个 session 中执行浏览器操作前都会先询问，包括通过 `@browser` 连接的 session；为某个站点在本次 session 中授权后不再重复询问

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to show the footer with the session link, model and cost only on its newest reply in a thread; the reply before it drops the footer
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 变更 Slack 中的 Claude：仅在话题中最新一条回复上显示包含 session 链接、模型和费用的页脚；其前一条回复不再显示页脚

items.en: Improved fullscreen mode: the link under the mouse pointer is now underlined to show it can be opened
items.zh: 改进全屏模式：鼠标指针下的链接现在会显示下划线，表示可以打开

items.en: Improved transcript toggle (ctrl+o) responsiveness in code-heavy conversations by caching syntax-highlighted code blocks
items.zh: 通过缓存语法高亮的代码块，改进代码密集对话中对话记录切换（ctrl+o）的响应速度

items.en: Improved Claude Desktop's Code tab behind a Claude apps gateway: when a session can't start, including on a machine not set up for the gateway's `code` settings, the reason shows as a reply
items.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关后的 Claude Desktop Code 标签页：当 session 无法启动时（包括在未配置网关 `code` 设置的机器上），原因会作为回复显示

items.en: Improved the errors for a refused cloud session: they now say why your organization's policy couldn't be loaded, and name an API key or auth token that overrides your claude.ai login
items.zh: 改进云 session 被拒绝时的错误信息：现在会说明为何无法加载你组织的策略，并指出覆盖你 claude.ai 登录的 API key 或 auth token

items.en: Improved `--debug` output to name unrecognized frontmatter fields in custom agent files, with a hint for likely typos
items.zh: 改进 `--debug` 输出，指出自定义 agent 文件中无法识别的 frontmatter 字段，并为可能的拼写错误提供提示

items.en: Improved auto mode: a tool call that wasn't run because auto mode's check had no usable answer now shows as a dim "Not run" row instead of a red error
items.zh: 改进自动模式：因自动模式的检查没有可用答案而未执行的工具调用，现在显示为灰色的“Not run”行，而不是红色错误

items.en: Improved `--debug` output for hooks: command hooks on tool calls, prompts, SessionStart and Stop now log their command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish, so a slow hook is identifiable
items.zh: 改进 hook 的 `--debug` 输出：工具调用、prompt、SessionStart 和 Stop 上的命令 hook 现在会在完成时记录其命令、plugin、结果和耗时，便于识别慢 hook

items.en: Improved `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`: a large transcript file is no longer rewritten when that would free under 10% of it
items.zh: 改进 `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`：如果重写大型 transcript 文件释放的空间不足 10%，则不再重写该文件

items.en: \[Code Review] Improved Code Review admin settings to say why a setting couldn't be saved, such as a policy restriction, instead of a generic failure message
items.zh: \[Code Review] 改进 Code Review 管理设置，在设置无法保存时说明原因（如策略限制），不再只显示笼统的失败信息

items.en: Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn
items.zh: 修复托管设置中通过 `"continue": false` 拒绝工具调用的 `PreToolUse` hook，以及阻止工具调用的托管 `prompt` hook 会拒绝该调用但未结束本轮的问题

items.en: Fixed PostToolUse hooks in managed settings not applying `updatedMCPToolOutput` in some sessions
items.zh: 修复托管设置中的 PostToolUse hook 在某些 session 中未应用 `updatedMCPToolOutput` 的问题

items.en: Fixed headless sessions starting a folder's `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP server that was switched off for that folder, after changing directory or reloading plugins
items.zh: 修复无头 session 在切换目录或重新加载 plugin 后，仍启动该文件夹已关闭的 `.mcp.json` 或 plugin MCP server 的问题

items.en: Fixed a Claude apps gateway that serves `allowedProviders` with `"gateway"` locking out laptops that name that gateway in user settings
items.zh: 修复当 Claude 应用网关以 `"gateway"` 提供 `allowedProviders` 时，在用户设置中指定该网关的笔记本电脑被拒之门外的问题

items.en: Fixed a saved Claude apps gateway sign-in being ignored on machines whose managed settings set `forceLoginMethod` to `gateway` with no `forceLoginGatewayUrl` (regression in 2.1.295)
items.zh: 修复在托管设置将 `forceLoginMethod` 设为 `gateway` 且未设置 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 的机器上，已保存的 Claude 应用网关登录被忽略的问题（2.1.295 引入的回归）

items.en: Fixed `--teleport` opening an empty conversation when the session's history could not be read
items.zh: 修复当 session 历史无法读取时，`--teleport` 打开空对话的问题

items.en: Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere
items.zh: 修复 Haiku 5.5 及其他仅支持自适应思考的模型的 token 计数问题：这些模型在某些网关后失败，在其他地方则按预算思考计数

items.en: Fixed resumed subagents being told that the user rejected a tool call that a session shutdown had interrupted
items.zh: 修复恢复的 subagent 被告知用户拒绝了某个工具调用的问题，而该调用实际是因 session 关闭而中断

items.en: Fixed hook output being altered when it contained text resembling a plugin hint tag
items.zh: 修复 hook 输出中包含类似 plugin 提示标签的文本时输出被改动的问题

items.en: Fixed secret redaction in shared transcripts and debug logs missing some values that follow a key with no value, including in JSON written inside a shell string
items.zh: 修复共享 transcript 和调试日志中的密钥脱敏遗漏部分值的问题，这些值位于无值的键之后，包括 shell 字符串内 JSON 中的情况

items.en: Fixed a stray `52;c;…` escape sequence printed on screen after copying in older VTE-based terminals such as MATE Terminal
items.zh: 修复在 MATE Terminal 等较旧的基于 VTE 的终端中复制后屏幕上打印多余 `52;c;…` 转义序列的问题

items.en: Fixed toasts and notifications waiting unseen for as long as the `/diff` panel or dialog was open
items.zh: 修复 toast 和通知在 `/diff` 面板或对话框打开期间一直未被看到的问题

items.en: Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through
items.zh: 修复在 `UserPromptSubmit` hook 或 mod 的 `prompt.submit` hook 期间按 Esc 或中断会导致无头 session 结束、清空已输入的 prompt，或让未经检查的 prompt 通过的问题

items.en: Fixed SessionStart hooks of a plugin loaded after a headless session starts being skipped when a different plugin with the same name, or another spelling of it, had already run
items.zh: 修复无头 session 启动后加载的 plugin 的 SessionStart hook 被跳过的问题：当同名或名称拼写不同的另一个 plugin 已运行过时会出现

items.en: Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` printing misleading errors when registration is refused: it now names the org admin setting, or says a restarted on-demand runner needs a fresh work order
items.zh: 修复 `claude self-hosted-runner` 在注册被拒时打印误导性错误的问题：现在会指明组织管理员设置，或说明重启的按需运行器需要新的工单

items.en: Fixed a self-hosted runner session's git fetch, pull and push failing while another session of the same repository starts on a runner with `--capacity` above 1
items.zh: 修复在 `--capacity` 大于 1 的运行器上，同一仓库的另一个 session 启动时，自托管运行器 session 的 git fetch、pull 和 push 失败的问题

items.en: Fixed workflow scripts silently truncating results, agent options and other values nested deeper than about 20,000 levels, and deeply nested results writing huge task output files
items.zh: 修复工作流脚本静默截断嵌套深度超过约 20,000 层的结果、agent 选项及其他值的问题，以及深层嵌套结果写入超大任务输出文件的问题

items.en: Fixed a plugin's served `$` methods running in the main session's working directory instead of the calling agent's, and ignoring the turn their calling hook holds
items.zh: 修复了 plugin 提供的 `$` 方法在调用方 agent 的工作目录中运行、而非在主 session 的工作目录中运行，以及忽略调用方 hook 所持有的轮次的问题

items.en: Fixed `$.agent.register` succeeding from a mod's hook that was still running after the mod was reloaded or removed; the call is now refused
items.zh: 修复了 mod 被重新加载或移除后，其仍在运行的 hook 中 `$.agent.register` 仍能成功的问题；现在该调用会被拒绝

items.en: Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `HEAD` request when the response declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit
items.zh: 修复了 mod 中的 `$.http.fetch` 在响应声明的 `Content-Length` 超过 4 MiB 正文上限时拒绝 `HEAD` 请求的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add`, `marketplace update` and `plugin install` failing with an internal error for a marketplace named like `constructor`; `add` now refuses such names clearly
items.zh: 修复了 `claude plugin marketplace add`、`marketplace update` 和 `plugin install` 对名称类似 `constructor` 的 marketplace 报内部错误而失败的问题；`add` 现在会明确拒绝此类名称

items.en: Fixed a plugin secret named `constructor` or `prototype` being deleted by the next save of that plugin's options
items.zh: 修复了名为 `constructor` 或 `prototype` 的 plugin 密钥在该 plugin 选项下一次保存时被删除的问题

items.en: Fixed cloud sessions skipping auto mode's checks on Claude in Chrome actions that a saved permission allows when their feature flags had not loaded
items.zh: 修复了功能标志尚未加载时，云 session 跳过自动模式对 Claude in Chrome 操作的检查的问题，而这些操作本已由已保存的权限允许

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a finished turn after a restart when an MCP tool result had ended that turn
items.zh: 修复了当 MCP 工具结果已结束该轮次时，`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 在重启后重新运行已完成的轮次的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some commands that assign the `BASH_ARGV0` shell variable and then use it; these now prompt for approval
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查自动批准某些先赋值 `BASH_ARGV0` shell 变量再使用它的命令的问题；这些命令现在会请求批准

items.en: Fixed Edit and NotebookEdit replacing every non-ASCII character in files that are not valid UTF-8 (Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK); such edits are now refused
items.zh: 修复了 Edit 和 NotebookEdit 在非有效 UTF-8 编码（Windows-1252、Shift-JIS、GBK）的文件中替换所有非 ASCII 字符的问题；此类编辑现在会被拒绝

items.en: Fixed a prompt sent just after `←` being run twice, once unseen in the foreground, when the background service was slow to answer
items.zh: 修复了在 `←` 之后立即发送的 prompt 被运行两次的问题：当后台服务响应缓慢时，其中一次在前台不可见地运行

items.en: Fixed a prompt sent while SessionStart hooks were still running vanishing when `←` moved the session to the background; it is still not sent, but `↑` now brings it back
items.zh: 修复了在 SessionStart hooks 仍在运行时发送的 prompt 在 `←` 将 session 移至后台后消失的问题；该 prompt 仍不会发送，但现在按 `↑` 可以将其找回

items.en: Fixed a late-loading plugin's SessionStart hook output reaching the new conversation after `/clear` in headless sessions
items.zh: 修复了延迟加载的 plugin 的 SessionStart hook 输出在无头 session 中于 `/clear` 之后进入新对话的问题

items.en: Fixed PowerShell commands not seeing variables that hooks write to CLAUDE\_ENV\_FILE (when the file holds only plain assignments)
items.zh: 修复了 PowerShell 命令看不到 hooks 写入 CLAUDE\_ENV\_FILE 的变量的问题（当该文件仅包含普通赋值时）

items.en: Fixed Claude calling cloud sessions non-interactive and suggesting `/mcp` or `claude mcp` when an MCP server needs authentication
items.zh: 修复了当 MCP server 需要认证时，Claude 将云 session 称为非交互式并建议使用 `/mcp` 或 `claude mcp` 的问题

items.en: Fixed `/code-review` ending on a raw JSON array in cloud sessions, the Agent SDK and IDE integrations; the findings now print as a numbered list
items.zh: 修复了 `/code-review` 在云 session、Agent SDK 和 IDE 集成中以原始 JSON 数组结尾的问题；发现项现在以编号列表形式输出

items.en: Fixed auto mode occasionally refusing one update to your own artifact, saying its sharing had changed when it had not
items.zh: 修复了自动模式偶尔拒绝对自己 artifact 的一次更新、并声称其共享设置已变更（实际并未变更）的问题

items.en: Fixed skills synced from claude.ai never finishing their install, and being downloaded again at every sync, when several sessions share a config directory
items.zh: 修复了当多个 session 共享同一配置目录时，从 claude.ai 同步的 skills 始终无法完成安装、且每次同步都会重新下载的问题

items.en: Fixed a plugin synced from claude.ai being disabled when the marketplace dependency it declares was also synced from claude.ai
items.zh: 修复了从 claude.ai 同步的 plugin 在其声明的 marketplace 依赖同样从 claude.ai 同步时被禁用的问题

items.en: Fixed a startup hang on macOS when plugin paths copied from a Linux machine pointed under /home
items.zh: 修复了在 macOS 上，当从 Linux 机器复制的 plugin 路径指向 /home 下时启动卡住的问题

items.en: Fixed the Workflow tool refusing script files with CRLF line endings, such as files checked out on Windows
items.zh: 修复了 Workflow 工具拒绝使用 CRLF 行尾的脚本文件（例如在 Windows 上检出的文件）的问题

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` or `git -C <dir> commit`
items.zh: 修复 OpenTelemetry `tool_result` 事件在 `git commit -q` 或 `git -C <dir> commit` 之后缺少 `git_commit_id` 的问题

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping a message from the saved transcript when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
items.zh: 修复 `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` 在消息文本包含 Unicode 行分隔符或段落分隔符（U+2028、U+2029）时从已保存的 transcript 中丢弃该消息的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude purge` leaving a prompt in the history file when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
items.zh: 修复 `claude purge` 在 prompt 文本包含 Unicode 行分隔符或段落分隔符（U+2028、U+2029）时将其残留在历史文件中的问题

items.en: Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands longer than about 1 KB always asking for permission, so allow rules and read-only detection now apply up to 32 KB
items.zh: Windows：修复超过约 1 KB 的 PowerShell 命令总是请求权限的问题，现在允许规则和只读检测可覆盖最长 32 KB 的命令

items.en: Windows: Fixed stdio MCP servers being force-killed at shutdown; stdin now closes first and the process tree is killed only if the server is still running after 300 ms
items.zh: Windows：修复 stdio MCP 服务器在关闭时被强制终止的问题；现在先关闭 stdin，仅当服务器在 300 ms 后仍在运行时才终止进程树

items.en: Windows: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub `owner/repo` plugin sources on machines with no GitHub SSH key; the clone is now retried over HTTPS
items.zh: Windows：修复在没有 GitHub SSH 密钥的机器上，`claude plugin install` 对 GitHub `owner/repo` plugin 源失败的问题；现在会通过 HTTPS 重试克隆

items.en: Windows: Fixed `rm -rf /c/Users/<name>` in Git Bash not asking in bypass permissions mode
items.zh: Windows：修复在 Git Bash 中执行 `rm -rf /c/Users/<name>` 时在 bypass permissions 模式下不请求权限的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` missing from the extension's settings, so settings.json now completes and validates it; a malformed value no longer breaks the chat panel
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复扩展设置中缺少 `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` 的问题，现在 settings.json 可对其补全和校验；格式错误的值不再导致聊天面板崩溃

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed chat links written as a full Windows path, such as C:\repo\file.ts or file:///C:/repo/file.ts, not opening the file on Windows
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复以完整 Windows 路径（如 C:\repo\file.ts 或 file:///C:/repo/file.ts）书写的聊天链接在 Windows 上无法打开文件的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the working indicator still animating when reduced motion is turned on in your OS, in VS Code, or with the `prefersReducedMotion` setting
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复在操作系统、VS Code 或 `prefersReducedMotion` 设置中开启减少动态效果后，工作指示器仍在播放动画的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock reading warm after the panel caught up on messages late, such as after the display was off or a remote window reconnected
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复面板延迟追上消息（例如显示器关闭或远程窗口重新连接后）时，prompt 缓存时钟错误显示为 warm 的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed every cloud session waiting for a self-hosted runner showing the same queue position; each now shows how many sessions are ahead of it
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复所有等待自托管运行器的 cloud session 显示相同排队位置的问题；现在每个 session 会显示前方还有多少个 session

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed a message you send while Claude is still replying in a cloud session jumping above that reply when it finishes; it now stays below it, including after a reload
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复在 cloud session 中 Claude 仍在回复时发送的消息在该回复完成后跳到其上方的问题；现在该消息保持在其下方，重新加载后也是如此

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed links to URLs that contain parentheses breaking in some of Claude's Slack replies and task checklists, which showed stray bracket text and opened the wrong page
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 的部分 Slack 回复和任务清单中指向含括号 URL 的链接失效的问题，此前会显示多余的括号文本并打开错误页面

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's Slack replies drawing color swatches beside codes that only look like hex colors, such as six-digit pull request numbers
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 的 Slack 回复在仅看似十六进制颜色的代码（如六位数的 pull request 编号）旁绘制色块的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed the plugin confirmation card Claude posts in a Slack channel showing a plugin's ID instead of its name
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 在 Slack 频道中发布的 plugin 确认卡片显示 plugin ID 而非名称的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a card to remove a plugin the channel's own settings don't include; it now explains where the plugin comes from instead
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 中的 Claude 发布卡片以移除该频道自身设置未包含的 plugin 的问题；现在改为说明该 plugin 的来源

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes losing its reply when a session in a self-hosted environment moved to a new runner partway through a task
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复 Slack 中的 Claude 在自托管环境中的 session 于任务进行中迁移到新运行器时有时丢失回复的问题

items.en: \[Code Review] Fixed the Code Review check sometimes staying "in progress" on a pull request after the review finished; it now shows the review's result
items.zh: \[Code Review] 修复 Code Review 检查在审查完成后有时在 pull request 上仍显示为“in progress”的问题；现在会显示审查结果

summary.tldr: 新增网关 code 策略、subagent 自动压缩窗口与多项修复，含密钥脱敏与权限安全修复。

highlights.title: 网关新增 code 策略键
highlights.detail: managed.policies[] 新增 code 键，设置同 cli，并在 Claude Desktop 的 Code 标签页生效；与 desktop 并列时开启网关模式。

highlights.title: subagent 可提前自动压缩
highlights.detail: subagent frontmatter 与 --agents 支持 autoCompactWindow，可让 subagent 比主对话更早触发上下文压缩。

highlights.title: Read 支持读取大文件
highlights.detail: Read 工具新增 allow_large，上下文有余量时可一次读取超出常规大小限制的文本文件。

highlights.title: 修复密钥脱敏遗漏
highlights.detail: 共享 transcript 与调试日志中，无值键之后的值（含 shell 字符串内 JSON）此前未被脱敏，现已修复。

highlights.title: Bash 权限检查收紧
highlights.detail: 先赋值 BASH_ARGV0 再使用的命令不再被自动批准，现在会请求批准；Windows 下 rm -rf 用户目录也会请求权限。

highlights.title: 后台化会停止当前回合
highlights.detail: 按 ← 将 session 转入后台时，已开始的回合或 ! 命令会被停止，而非在后台继续完成。
